newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CIM Stratford mine makes record sales.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CIM Stratford mine makes record sales.

text.p: Hunter Valley coal miner CIM Resources Ltd said on Thursday its Stratford coal mine had reported record production and sales for the September quarter.
Coal output reached 422,000 tonnes, an increase of 85 percent over the production recorded in the corresponding quarter last year, CIM said.
Coal sales for the quarter were about 572,000 tonnes, an increase of 150 percent over sales in the corresponding Quarter last year and about 13 percent ahead of budget, the company said.

The company also said it had concluded arrangements with a bank syndicate to refinance the company's debt through a A$40 million facility which was expected to lead to a significant saving in interest costs.

On the acquisitions front, CIM said it had a number of acquisitions under review with the Hunter Valley the most likely location of any purchase, but it was not contemplating any further action on Cumnock Coal Ltd.
CIM said on September 26 it had lost interest in a partnership with or acquisition of Cumnock.
CIM shares closed a cent higher at 79 cents on turnover of 683,000 shares.
